_comment: Advisories consciously accepted for now, checked by scripts/audit-deps.mjs.
Each entry needs a reason and a review date. An expired entry FAILS the build,
so a waiver cannot rot into a permanent hole — somebody has to look again.
Only add an entry when there is genuinely no fixed release to upgrade to.

allow.reason: Nine high advisories affect every published 16.x; npm's only suggested fix is a downgrade to 9.3.3, which is not a real option. Running the latest available (16.2.12). Two are directly relevant to this app and need compensating controls until a patched release ships: GHSA-6gpp-xcg3-4w24 (middleware bypass) and GHSA-955p-x3mx-jcvp (server function endpoint disclosure).

Reached only through the Tailwind build toolchain; the vulnerable paths (sourceMappingURL auto-loading, CSS stringify) run at build time on our own stylesheets, not on user input. Revisit when @tailwindcss/postcss ships an updated dependency.
Transitive, reached only through schema validation in the build tooling. No user-controlled URI parsing on a request path. Revisit at the next dependency refresh.

Transitive via Next's image optimisation. The app serves no user-uploaded images through the optimiser; attachments are streamed from the database by their own route. Revisit when Next bumps its sharp dependency.
